content: इषि(षी)का [इष् गत्यादौ क्वुन् अत इत्वम्] .²1 Reed, rush, stalk of grass; कुशकाशशरेषिकाः <ls>Rām.</ls>; <ls>Kaṭh. 2. 6. 17</ls>. ˚अस्त्रम् <ls>R. 12. 23</ls>. .²2 An arrow. .²3 A sort of sugar-cane; Saccharum Spontaneum. .²4 A small stick of wood or iron used to see whether gold in a crucible is melted or not. .²5 A brush. .²6 The eye-ball of an elephant. .²7 A thorny plant; संनिकर्षादिषीकाभिर्मोचितः परमाद्भयात् <ls>Rām. 2. 8. 30</ls>.
